summary: Use hyphens only when they prevent ambiguity in compound terms, with examples like little-used car versus little used-car.
questions: When should compound adjectives be hyphenated in docs?

answer_card.title: Hyphen usage
answer_card.answer_md: Hyphenate only to avoid ambiguity: "a little-used car" vs "a little used-car", "cross-complaint", "fine-tooth comb". If the compound can't be misread, skip the hyphen.
